mapper.select: select r.id as resultId, r.instance_id as instanceId, r.request_id as requestId, r.outcome as outcome, r.member_id as memberId, substring(cast(r.evidence_checked_at as varchar), 1, 19) as evidenceCheckedAt, substring(cast(r.created_at as varchar), 1, 19) as createdAt, i.status as instanceStatus, i.accepted_by as acceptedBy, i.region_id as regionId, i.board_id as boardId, i.season_id as seasonId, i.rules_release_id as rulesReleaseId, i.release_id as releaseId, i.content_hash as contentHash, q.member_id as requestMemberId, q.state as requestState, q.http_status as httpStatus from city_onsite_task_result r join city_onsite_task_instance i on r.instance_id = i.id join city_onsite_task_request q on r.request_id = q.request_id where r.id = #{resultId}
